note: Both sets read the stacked bar chart of layup layer thickness vs. span position and both contain values lifted from total bar heights and misbound to thin layers (e.g. glass_biax at 18–45 mm, when the pink layer is only a few mm thick). Set A is the more faithful of the two: it covers the dominant medium_density_foam layer for both web0 and web1 at several span positions with plausible values, and its errors are confined to glass_biax claims carrying total-thickness values. Set B additionally misbinds CarbonUD to 13, 18 and 37 mm values that cannot belong to that thin top layer, and gives almost no foam coverage for web1. Both sets contain internally contradictory near-duplicates (e.g. 3 vs 4 mm glass_biax at the same position) and neither quote is verbatim text from the page.
